title: Polish Vegetable Wrap
description: A delicious and healthy wrap filled with steamed vegetables and polish sausage. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.name: Steamed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as cabbage, carrots, and onions

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Grill the polish sausage for 5-7 minutes, or until browned and cooked through.
3. Slice the sausage into thin strips.
4. Steam the vegetables for 3-5 minutes, or until tender.
5. Warm the large flour tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
6. Assemble the wrap by spreading mayonnaise and mustard on the tortilla, then adding the sliced sausage and steamed vegetables.
7. Wrap the small flour tortilla around the filling to create a tight roll.
8. Slice in half and serve immediately.
